scope: Follow-up implementation self-review of the independent MCP project; not an independent penetration test or a claim of no vulnerabilities.

findings.issue: Unknown parameter names were echoed into validation errors.
findings.fix: Bound unknown-key messages to the declared argument names; cap malformed argument containers at 64 total members/elements.

findings.issue: Malformed complete protocol frames each emitted a diagnostic and continued reading.
findings.fix: Close damaged protocol streams after one bounded diagnostic. Ordinary invalid tool arguments still return isError and retain the session.

findings.issue: Closing the transport alone could leave the process waiting on an open parent input pipe.
findings.before: The new shutdown regression did not exit within 10 seconds.
findings.after: Connected SIGTERM shutdown exits with code 0 while the parent input pipe remains open.
findings.fix: Release stdin after server close; test both damaged streams and connected shutdown.

syntheticProperties.scope: Deterministic correctness and reconstruction checks, not security proof.

checks.provenance: 14 copied core files remain hash-matched; no copied algorithm was edited.
